name: change-control
description: Review forge change history and branch protection, identify segregation-of-duties exceptions, and land owned findings and window evidence in Noru.

interface.shortDescription: Turn change history into owned segregation-of-duties evidence.
interface.longDescription: Exports GitHub or GitLab change history and branch protection for a review window, checks whether author, approver, merger and deployer separation held, and writes a reviewable manifest in which every exception has a disposition and named owner. After confirmation, it lands one finding per exception and the window's account as evidence in Noru.
capabilities: Author, approver, merger and deployer separation checks
Owned exceptions and window evidence in Noru
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this repository's change controls for the last 90 days and show me what would land in Noru.
